summary: Rehearsed on the clone's copy of production after the rulings of 2026-09-27: Copy again as its own step (and, in rehearsal 7, giving the one ownerless pick list with a single-organization maker its organization), then the press for every organization (the 7 other ownerless lists archived with no owner organization), an Undo that carried a new-system edit back and restored those lists, Copy again, the press again, and the Undo again.

steps.result: Every organization is ready. Pressing switches 31 organizations at once.
